scope: Unauthenticated public documentation review only; no provider/RPC request, no credentials/key/environment dump, no tests or repository source edits

quotes.subject: Broad history claim
quotes.classification: Broad claim; membership and retention not defined here
quotes.quote: > getTransactionsForAddress returns complete Solana transaction history for an address in one call — time, slot, and status filters, sorting, and keyset paging.

quotes.subject: Result bound
quotes.classification: Explicit per-request maximum, rather than unbounded one-call wallet history
quotes.quote:
<ParamField body="limit" type="number" default="1000">
  Maximum number of transactions per request. Use 1–1000 for transactionDetails:"signatures" and 1–1000 for transactionDetails:"full".

quotes.subject: Commitment
quotes.classification: Explicit: finalized default; confirmed allowed; processed unsupported
quotes.quote:
<ParamField body="commitment" type="string" default="finalized">
  The commitment level for the request. The `processed` commitment is not supported.

  * `confirmed`
  * `finalized`

quotes.subject: Full transaction formats
quotes.classification: Explicit: full encodings json/jsonParsed/base58/base64; set maxSupportedTransactionVersion 1 for legacy/v0/v1
quotes.quote:
<ParamField body="encoding" type="string" default="json">
  Encoding format for transaction data (applies only when transactionDetails=full).

  * `json`
  * `jsonParsed`
  * `base58`
  * `base64`
</ParamField>

<ParamField body="maxSupportedTransactionVersion" type="number">
  Maximum transaction version to return (applies only when transactionDetails=full). Set to 1 to receive legacy, v0, and v1 transactions.

quotes.subject: Status
quotes.classification: Explicit: status default any; succeeded/failed/any options
quotes.quote:
<ParamField body="filters.status" type="string" default="any">
  Filter by transaction status.

  * `succeeded`
  * `failed`
  * `any`

quotes.subject: Token-account membership wording
quotes.classification: Explicit inclusion option and owned-by wording; temporal ownership, program coverage and account subtypes not defined
quotes.quote:
<ParamField body="filters.tokenAccounts" type="string" default="none">
  Filter transactions for related token accounts. Controls whether to include transactions involving token accounts owned by the address.

  * `none`
  * `balanceChanged`
  * `all`
</ParamField>

quotes.subject: Transfer-filter narrowing
quotes.quote:
<ParamField body="filters.tokenTransfer" type="object">
  Narrows results to transactions where the queried address participated in a token transfer matching specific criteria. All fields are optional and combined with AND semantics.

quotes.subject: OpenAPI associated-account wording
quotes.classification: Uses associated token accounts but does not define coverage of non-ATA accounts
quotes.quote:
- Token account support (include transactions for associated token
        accounts)

quotes.subject: Signature result nullable timestamp
quotes.classification: Explicit null blockTime allowed; no handling rule for null timestamps in blockTime filtering stated
quotes.quote:
blockTime:
                                  oneOf:
                                    - type: integer
                                      description: >-
                                        Estimated production time as Unix
                                        timestamp
                                    - type: 'null'
                                  description: >-
                                    Estimated production time as Unix timestamp
                                    (seconds since epoch), or null if not
                                    available.

quotes.subject: Full metadata shape
quotes.classification: Explicit metadata shape incl err/fee/balances/token balances/innerInstructions/logMessages/compute units; not a completeness/retention guarantee for every historical field
quotes.quote:
meta:
                                  type: object
                                  description: >-
                                    Transaction status metadata — same shape as
                                    getTransaction, including err, fee,
                                    preBalances/postBalances,
                                    preTokenBalances/postTokenBalances,
                                    innerInstructions, logMessages, and
                                    computeUnitsConsumed.

quotes.subject: Full result nullable timestamp
quotes.quote:
blockTime:
                                  oneOf:
                                    - type: integer
                                      description: >-
                                        Estimated production time as Unix
                                        timestamp
                                    - type: 'null'
                                  description: >-
                                    Estimated production time as Unix timestamp
                                    (seconds since epoch), or null if not
                                    available.

quotes.subject: Terminal pagination
quotes.classification: Explicit next-page token or null if no more results for declared query
quotes.quote:
paginationToken:
                        oneOf:
                          - type: string
                            description: Token for retrieving the next page of results
                          - type: 'null'
                        description: >-
                          Pagination token for next page, or null if no more
                          results.

interpretation.owner_membership: The reference does not specify current-versus-event-time ownership, account close/reopen/reassignment intervals, non-ATA coverage, legacy versus Token-2022 program membership, or whether observed ownership authorizes all past/future transactions for an account. The owned-by and associated-account phrases alone do not establish that contract.
interpretation.cutoff_retention: No after-2022 cutoff or retention floor/promise appears in this reference. A cutoff in a separate guide must be attributed to that guide.
interpretation.terminal: A null paginationToken marks exhaustion of results for the declared query. This alone does not establish exhaustive whole-wallet historical membership.
interpretation.exclusions: Processed commitment is explicitly unsupported. Status and tokenTransfer/time/slot/signature filters can narrow results. Version handling for unsupported versions and nullable timestamps in time-filtered queries are not specified as failure versus omission.
interpretation.paid_necessity: This reference provides no plan or billing necessity statement; no paid necessity is inferred.
